write_up: You moved from tutoring at City Year Baltimore to coordinating and then managing youth workforce programs at Harbor Pathways. A recruiter can follow that path and would likely move your resume forward with questions, particularly about how many students and employers your current program reaches.

Your tutoring line is a good model: it names the grade and both subjects, so the work is easy to understand. Your current role also shows the people you supervise, but it doesn't yet say what that team handles or what the program has achieved.
Let's start with the summer jobs program. Add the number of students served and a result you can stand behind, then give the same treatment to the employer partnerships and participant tracking.
